w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE REDACTOR! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (The Callback, The Ugly Beast, Spool, Big Loud) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Terms of Service is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: The Callback stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Ad Break.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📼 RERUN ×2 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +50% HP, +24% damage, +1 in the pack.)
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "COMBAT! THE STRIKE! The gamblers lean in. ROUND 1 — FIGHT!"
📼 RERUN ×2 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +50% HP, +24% damage, +1 in the pack.)
You walk in open-handed — and it goes wrong. They don't want peace. You're exposed, off-balance, nowhere to slip to until your next turn. (Walk In failed.)
You focus — that costs your action.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
firstContext: 🍽️ Fatima watches another basket arrive and laughs. "We're feeding the shelves more than ourselves. Not today."
✦ Valentina has found something — Talked Down. Days of silver_tongue and peacemaker side by side, and now they move as one. (talked_down: villager synergy discovered)
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
— DAY 110 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Dandelion went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: A curious wanderer waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
That night, they bring Manaaki home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "It is today. You dreamed about the cameras. Everyone did. The village is very quiet."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (13/8/6), with 4 wave-4 fought, 13 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE WITNESS — "Offer them a way back."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Luis Fernandez ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
